items.title: Sennheiser Momentum True Wireless 5 Launches in India With User-Replaceable Batteries
items.summary: Sennheiser launched the Momentum True Wireless 5 in India at Rs 29,990, featuring 7mm TrueResponse drivers, Bluetooth 6.0, aptX Lossless and up to 40 hours of total battery life. A standout feature is user-replaceable batteries in both earbuds and the charging case, targeting longer product life and e-waste reduction.

items.title: OPPO Enco X3s Premium TWS Earbuds Debut Globally Alongside Find X9 Series
items.summary: OPPO introduced the Enco X3s premium TWS earbuds worldwide, offering Hi-Res Audio with the LDHC 5.0 codec, dual dynamic drivers with dual DACs, 55dB ANC across a 5,500Hz range, IP55 rating and AI Translate. International pricing starts at EUR 129.

items.title: Fairphone Fairbuds 2 Revealed: Modular Repairable Earbuds Launching October 14 at EUR 119
items.summary: Fairphone confirmed the Fairbuds 2 will launch on October 14, 2026, with seven fully replaceable modular parts and new support for Sony's LDAC hi-res codec, up from SBC/AAC on the original. Priced at EUR 119 in Europe and USD 119 in the US, the earbuds target sustainable TWS with a lower entry cost.

items.title: Bose Unveils Sport Open and Ultra Open Earbuds 2nd Gen With Cinema Mode and Wireless Charging
items.summary: Bose announced the Sport Open Earbuds and Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen), its most serious open-ear push yet. The Ultra Open 2 adds a redesigned driver with deeper bass, up to 9 hours playback, a wireless charging upright case, SpeechClarity calls and a new Cinema Mode, shipping October 1 for USD 299.

items.title: CNET Tests the Best Wireless Earbuds of 2026, Crowns Sony WF-1000XM6 Overall
items.summary: CNET updated its 2026 earbuds roundup after hands-on testing of dozens of models. The Sony WF-1000XM6 tops the list with class-leading ANC and 8-mic call quality, while the Apple AirPods Pro 3, Anker Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro and Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro are named best for their ecosystems.

items.title: SoundGuys Reviews Bose Ultra Open Earbuds 2nd Gen: Better Sound, Still Pricey at USD 299
items.summary: SoundGuys tested the Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) and found the redesign lifts its Multi-Dimensional Audio Quality score from 2.3 to 2.9, with stronger bass and tamed treble. Calls still falter in wind and noise, and at USD 299 the reviewer would not buy them over cheaper clip-on rivals.

items.title: Open-Ear Earbuds Boom 12% While Traditional TWS Shipments Stall, Omdia Says
items.summary: New Omdia Q2 2026 data shows open wireless stereo shipments grew 12% to 11.1 million units even as conventional TWS slipped 0.7% to 82.1 million, the category's first annual decline since 2023. Clip-on designs took 61% of OWS volume, and the sub-USD 50 tier surged 323% year over year.

items.title: AirPods Hold Top Spot as Global TWS Shipments Fall for First Time Since 2023
items.summary: Omdia's Q2 2026 tracker puts Apple at 16.8 million TWS units and 20.5% share, up 1.2% year over year, even as the total market contracted 0.7%. OPPO was the only other top-five vendor to grow, while Xiaomi, Samsung and Huawei all declined; Shokz led open-ear with 107.9% growth.

items.title: AirPods Pro 3 Review: Heart-Rate Sensing and Live Translation Redefine the Buds
items.summary: Showmetech's full AirPods Pro 3 analysis highlights the new PPG heart-rate sensor reading blood flow 256 times per second, real-time Live Translation across ten languages, Conversation Detection and Hearing Aid mode. Battery rises to 8-9 hours per charge while the case total drops to about 24 hours.

items.title: JLab Debuts JBuds Mini ANC With Apple Find My at IFA 2026
items.summary: At IFA 2026 JLab unveiled the JBuds Mini ANC, claimed as the smallest TWS earbuds from a major brand, adding Active Noise Cancellation, Spatial Audio and Apple Find My compatibility as the first non-Apple, non-Beats earbuds to do so. The GO Sport ANC and JBuds Open Sport 2 also joined the lineup.
